Tools and packages developed to address everyday challenges in science
and beyond.

## Packages

::: {.pub-list}
- **AcademiCV**\
  Semi-automatic template for generating academic CVs. Built with
  JavaScript and Node.js, AcademiCV converts structured data into
  professionally formatted Microsoft Word and HTML documents,
  simplifying the maintenance, versioning, and publication of academic
  records.

  **Current version:** `2.1.0` — adds optional automatic synchronization
  with Quarto websites, enabling seamless updates of online academic
  profiles.

```bash
  git clone https://github.com/Luca-Sclisizzo/AcademiCV.git
  cd AcademiCV
  npm install
```

  [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Luca-Sclisizzo/AcademiCV.git){.pub-badge target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
  [Changelog](https://github.com/Luca-Sclisizzo/AcademiCV/releases/){.pub-badge target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
:::

## Data & Code

Data, analysis scripts, and preregistrations for individual papers are linked
directly from each entry on the [Publications](publications.qmd) page, so they sit
next to the study they belong to rather than in a separate index.
